glosses: astronaut (a member of the crew of a spaceship or other spacecraft, or someone trained for that purpose)

examples.en: He is dreaming of becoming an astronaut.

examples.text: Les astronautes sont revenus sur Terre sains et saufs.
examples.en: The astronauts returned safely to Earth.

examples.text: L'astronaute a dû faire plein d'expériences dans la navette spatiale.
examples.en: The astronaut had to conduct many experiments in the space shuttle.

examples.text: Les astronautes ont été accueillis par les acclamations et les applaudissements d'une foule enthousiaste.
examples.en: The astronauts were greeted with cheers and applause of an enthusiastic crowd.
